description_en: Queries the statistics on HTTP status codes of a website
description_zh: 查询网站业务的响应状态码统计信息
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo describe-domain-status-code-list --resource-group-id rg-acfm2pz25js0000 --start-time 1582992000 --end-time 1583683200 --interval 1000 --domain www.example.com --query-type upstream --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDomainStatusCodeList

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS高防实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组。

关于资源组的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The start time of the event. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

This UNIX timestamp must indicate a point in time that is accurate to the minute
parameters.help_zh:
查询开始时间。使用时间戳格式，单位：秒。
必须为整点分钟
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

This UNIX timestamp must indicate a point in time that is accurate to the minute
parameters.help_zh:
查询结束时间。使用时间戳格式，单位：秒。
必须为整点分钟
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The interval for returning data. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 返回数据的步长，单位为秒，即每隔多少秒返回一个查询结果
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en:
The domain name of the website. If you do not specify this parameter, the statistics on response status codes of all domain names are queried.

A forwarding rule must be configured for the domain name. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html operation to query all domain names
parameters.help_zh:
网站业务的域名。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html查询所有已接入DDoS高防防护的网站业务的域名
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en:
The source of the statistics. Valid values:

gf: Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium
upstrem: origin server
parameters.help_zh:
查询数据的来源。取值：
gf：表示高防响应数据。
upstream：表示源站响应数据
parameters.name: query_type
